999008199.text: ここが現場なんですね。案内をありがとうございます

localizations.en: So this is where it happened. Thank you for showing us.

999008199.text:
お安いご用さ。
しかし、まるで手掛かりが掴めずにいるんだ

localizations.en: Don't mention it. But we haven't been able to find a single lead so far.

999008199.text: それでも諦めずに、手掛かりを探さなきゃ……あっ

localizations.en: We still can't give up—we have to keep searching for clues... Oh!

999008199.text:
あっちにいるのは、漁師の人たちかな？
もしかしたら、ここ最近の海の様子が聞けるかも

localizations.en: Are those fishermen over there? Maybe they've noticed something about the recent changes in the sea.

999008199.text: ああ。話を聞いてみよう

localizations.en: Right. Let's go talk to them.

999008199.text:
ああ。瀕死の魔物が海に浮かんでるのを発見したのは
俺たち、漁師連中だよ

localizations.en: Yeah. We fishermen were the ones who first discovered the dying monsters floating in the water.

999008199.text:
そもそも海の魔物が他の魔物を襲ったというわけでは
ないのか？

localizations.en: Could it simply be that sea monsters attacked other creatures?

999008199.text:
最初はそう思ったもんだったが、
普段陸にいる魔物が浮かんでたんだよ。だからよぉ……

localizations.en: That's what we thought at first, but the monsters floating out there were the kind that usually stay on land. So, y'know...

999008199.text: ああ。やっぱりあいつらの仕業かもしれないな

localizations.en: Yeah. It might be those guys' doing after all.

999008199.text: あいつら……ですか？

昔な。星じゃなく海を信仰して、
生贄を海に捧げて救いを求める集団がいたんだよ

localizations.en: Long ago, there was a group that worshiped the sea instead of the stars. They'd offer sacrifices to the sea, seeking salvation.

999008199.text:
実際に出会ったことは無いが、
そいつらの仕業なんじゃないかと噂になってるんだ

localizations.en: I've never actually met them myself, but there are rumors going around that this might be their work.

999008199.text:
ともかく、気の荒い魔物が群がってくるせいで、
俺たちの仕事も思ったようにできなくなってんだ

localizations.en: Either way, with all these aggressive monsters swarming around, we can't do our jobs properly anymore.

999008199.text:
早くどうにかなればいいんだが……
最近、姿を見せなくなった漁師もいる

localizations.en: I hope this gets sorted out soon... Recently, one of the fishermen stopped showing up.

999008199.text: 廃業したということか？

いや。漁師は星からいただいた役目だからな。
魔物にやられたんじゃないかと心配してるよ

localizations.en: No way. Being a fisherman is a role given to us by the stars. We're worried he might've been killed by monsters.

999008199.text: 役目……

ともかく、その漁師を訪ねてみよう。
無事なら、少しは安心できるだろうしな

localizations.en: In any case, let's try visiting that fisherman. If he's safe, it'll at least put our minds at ease.

999008199.text: ああ。頼むよ
では、失礼する

localizations.en: We'll be on our way, then.

999008199.text: ちょっといいかな？

おっ、なんだい？
……変わった仮面を付けてるね！？

localizations.en: Hm? What is it? Whoa, that's quite the mask you're wearing!

999008199.text:
かっこいいだろう！　ブラオールでも大人気なんだよ。
ところで、今の話が聞こえたんだけどさ

localizations.en: Pretty cool, right? It's super popular in Braulle! Anyway, I couldn't help overhearing your conversation.

999008199.text: その瀕死の魔物って、重りが付けられてたりしたの？

localizations.en: Those dying monsters—were any of them weighed down with something?

999008199.text: 重り？　そんなものは付けられていないようだったな

localizations.en: Weights? No, there wasn't anything like that attached to them.

999008199.text:
そうか。ちょっと気になったものでね。
ありがとう
まさかと思って来てみたけど……やっぱり違うか

localizations.en: I came here thinking it might be related, but... guess I was wrong.
